newsitem.title: UK: Fleming Investment Trust enters KEPIT fray.
newsitem.headline: Fleming Investment Trust enters KEPIT fray.

text.p: Fleming Investment Trust Management Limited (FITM) said on Wednesday it had put forward proposals to the board of Kleinwort European Privatisation Investment Trust (KEPIT).
FITM said in a statement that it had confirmed "certain proposals" had been made following press commment.
The 500 million stg KEPIT trust is currently the subject of a takeover bid by TR European Growth Trust Plc.

TR European Growth Fund's (TREG) hostile bid opened the field for others to compete for the mandate to run KEPIT, with at least 10 groups competing for it. On Friday KEPIT told shareholders to reject a second offer from TREG.
FITM said its proposals were subject to the recommendation of the KEPIT board.

"No reported information should be relied upon in relation to the nature or possible financial effects of the proposals. Specifically, the suggestion in the press comment that the proposals may involve the offer of cash in excess of 99 percent of net asset value is inaccurate," it said.
It said a further announcement would be made in due course "if appropriate".
